content.text:
The full build succeeds. The change is complete.

I implemented the audit logging in the owner-create endpoint (`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`, the handler for `POST /api/owners`):

1. Added an `org.slf4j.Logger` named `"AUDIT"` as a static field.
2. After `saveOwner(...)` succeeds, it emits:
   ```
   AUDIT.info("Owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={}",
       owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate());
   ```

The log line is placed after the save so `owner.getId()` is populated, and it carries all three required values — owner id, `customerCode`, and `registrationDate`. The registration date renders in ISO form (`2026-08-17`), matching the JSON representation the test reads back. The acceptance test `coreLogsAuditOnCreate` and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
